record.dic_text:
01183 B@`alyah {be-al-ya:'}

源自 01167 和 03050; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Bealiah 1; 1

比亞利雅 = "耶和華是主"
1) 在洗革拉加入大衛陣營的一位便雅憫人, 是大衛的大能勇士之一 (#代上 12:5|)
record.edic_text:
01183 B@`alyah {beh-al-yaw'}

from 01167 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Bealiah 1; 1

Bealiah = "Jehovah is master"
1) a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's
   mighty warriors
